spans.s: शय (I) a. (f. या or यी) (generally at the end of a compound) Lying down, sleeping, e.g. उत्तानशय, दिवाशय.
शय (II) m. 1. Sleep; 2. a snake; 3. a bed, a couch; 4. abuse, imprecation; 5. a hand.
शय (I) a. (f. या or यी) (generally at the end of a compound) Lying down, sleeping, e.g. उत्तानशय, दिवाशय.
शय्या f. 1. A bed, a sofa, शय्या पुष्पमयी Sak.iii., R.v.65, 66; 2. tying, stringing together.
साय m. 1. End, close, termination; 2. evening; 3. an arrow.
शय (I) a. (f. या or यी) (generally at the end of a compound) Lying down, sleeping, e.g. उत्तानशय, दिवाशय.
शयथ m. 1. Death; 2. a boar; 3. a fish; 4. a sort of snake.
शयन n. 1. Sleeping, sleep; 2. a bed, a couch, R.i.95, M.vi.40; 3. copulation.
सायन n. The longitude of a planet reckoned from the vernal equinoctial point.
शयन-अगार m.n. a bed-chamber.
शयन-गृह n. a bed-chamber.
शयन-एकादशी f. the eleventh day of the first half of Āshāḍha when Viṣṇu sleeps.
शयन-सखी f. a bed-fellow.
शयन-स्थान n. a sleeping-apartment.
शयनीय n. A bed, a couch, परिशून्यं शयनीयमद्य मे R.viii.66.
शयानक m. 1. A lizard; 2. a kind of snake.
शयालु (I) a. Sleepy.
शयालु (II) m. 1. A kind of snake; 2. a dog; 3. a jackal.
शयित a. (f. ता) 1. Sleeping, asleep; 2. lying down, Bh.V.ii.182.
शयित a. (f. ता) 1. Sleeping, asleep; 2. lying down, Bh.V.ii.182.
शयु m. A large snake.
शय्या-अध्यक्ष, -पाल m. guardian of a king’s bed-chamber.
शय्या-अध्यक्ष, -पाल m. guardian of a king’s bed-chamber.
शय्या-उत्संग m. the side of a bed.
शय्या-गृह n. a bed-chamber, R.xvi.4.
शायक m. 1. An arrow; 2. a sword. Cf. सायक.
सायक m. 1. An arrow, धनुष्यमोघं समधत्त सायकम् R.iii.53; 2. a sword.
सय् vt. 1Ā (pres. सयते) To go, to move.
सयूथ्य m. One of the same tribe.
सयोनि (I) a. Having the same womb, uterine.
सयोनि (II) m. 1. A uterine brother; 2. a pair of nippers for cutting betel-nut.
सायक-पुंख m. the feathered end of an arrow, सक्तांगुलिः सायकपुंख एव चित्रार्पितारंभ इवावतस्थे R.ii.31.
सायम् ind. In the evening, सायं संयमिनस्तस्य महर्षेर्महिषीसखः R.i.48, 90.
सायाह्न m. evening, eventide.
सायाह्न m. evening, eventide.
सायम्-तन a. belonging to the evening, vespertine, सायंतने सवनकर्मणि संप्रवृत्ते Sak.iii.
सायम्-मंडन n. sunset.
सायिन् m. A horseman.
सायुज्य n. 1. Intimate union, identification (especially with a deity) (one of the four grades of Mukti); 2. similarity, likeness.
